notes: «سألت أبا مسعود» makes the asked man a link, and he is the one who relays the Prophet's words («فقال قال رسول الله»), so he is the last link.
«أبا مسعود» is a kunya written as it stands (owner ruling 3); K6I's identification with a named companion is not used.
«وهو يطوف بالبيت» is the scene only.
